title: Plurals of clothes
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y9 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: plurals of clothes)
intro: Lesson 35: Plurals of clothes. To understand how clothing words form their plurals, especially broken plurals

questions.q: Make plural with adjective: فُسْتَانٌ طَوِيلٌ
questions.model: Teacher: plural of فُسْتَان is فَسَاتِين (no tanwin on this pattern). Plural things take a feminine singular adjective: طَوِيلَةٌ.

questions.q: Plural practice on the pupil PDF: give the plurals of ten clothing words with an adjective each; then write a shop window description of five plural items. Start: فِي النَّافِذَةِ ...
questions.a: Correct plurals and feminine singular adjectives, for example: مَعَاطِفُ شَتَوِيَّةٌ؛ أَحْذِيَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ
questions.model: Teacher writes: فِي النَّافِذَةِ قُمْصَانٌ بَيْضَاءُ وَأَحْذِيَةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ.

questions.q: use a number 3 to 10 with a clothing plural.
Back to our ponder: how can we learn broken plurals?
questions.a: Learn each with its plural; spot patterns
